name: Detect Key
description: Find the key (and mode) of a MIDI clip, ticked track(s), or the whole Set. Krumhansl-Schmuckler pitch-class analysis. Same 7 notes can be 7 modes — home is picked from the bass, downbeats and final notes; a real tie is reported, not guessed.

fields.label: Scope: clip, track, or set
fields.hint: clip = the selected/detail MIDI clip. track = every clip on ticked MIDI track(s) — tick track(s) on the left first. set = every MIDI clip in the whole Live Set.

fields.label: Profile: krumhansl-kessler or temperley
fields.hint: Which published pitch-class weight table to correlate against. krumhansl-kessler is the classic, most-tested choice; temperley is a later revision that leans differently on some scale degrees.

fields.label: How many results to show (1-12)
fields.hint: Top N key/mode guesses to report, best match first.
